title: Cozy Stay in Pittsburgh – Family Room
description:
A spacious family room with a king bed and a queen bed. It sleeps up to 4 adults plus 2 children, so it's a great fit for families.

Cozy Stay in Pittsburgh is a family-friendly homestay in Swissvale, a very safe and peaceful borough 9 miles east of downtown Pittsburgh. Your hosts, Ilkay & Hilton, live in the house and are happy to share tips for making the most of your trip. We speak English and Turkish.

Guests share the kitchen, the lounge and a business area, and there's a terrace to relax on. The house has air conditioning, free Wi-Fi, streaming services and free private parking on site. Breakfast and airport transportation are available on request for an extra charge.

Getting around: 10 minutes to Shadyside, 5 minutes to Squirrel Hill and about 20 minutes to Pittsburgh International Airport. Nearly everywhere you'll want to go is within 15 minutes. Chatham University is 3.1 mi away and Carnegie Mellon University 3.7 mi. Frick Park is 1.9 mi, Schenley Park 3.4 mi, Phipps Conservatory 4.1 mi, the Carnegie Museums 4.2 mi, the Pittsburgh Zoo & PPG Aquarium 5 mi and the Andy Warhol Museum 7 mi.
